See you at 2:30.

I drafted a one-paragraph addendum we can attach to the offer; I've also redlined the Word offer (see attached).

- We will offer Sabrina the March 22 start date.
- DocuSign packet will include the main offer + one-paragraph prior-inventions addendum (as an attachment) to be signed together.
- If Sabrina prefers an earlier start and an advisory overlap, we will include a short consultancy agreement (2 pages) that compensates for advisory hours; otherwise we expect full-time start on March 22.

Courtney/Sabrina — I'll upload the redlined Word and the addendum to DocuSign. Sabrina, please confirm acceptance of the March 22 start or if you'd like the consultancy path so we can add that to the packet.
